cls: New about_flags entries always go at the end (I think there are comments about this at the beginning and end of the list, but the list is 10k lines long so who would see them lol)
Unrelated to this CL, but a side thought: Do we care to measure how many Pix code copies come in through CCT vs. non-CCT? It might be a good idea to add a UMA metric for the origin of the copy so…
I recommend not having "FlagEnabled" in test names because once the flag gets cleaned up it's very common to forget to rename these, and then later people are like "uh what flag?". IMO the better…
Also: The alternate test needs a `InitAndDisableFeature(kEnablePixInCct)` line. Otherwise once you enable your new flag by default, some test somewhere will fail.
Add period to the end of the Description (but not the Name)
For some reason there's a really big push for doing it this way among Chrome reviewers lately, so: ``` base::test::ScopedFeatureList feature_list{kEnablePixInCct}; ```
